ideas.title: 01 One-touch warm button

new_nodes.label: Warm-press button
new_nodes.detail: A single big button starts a safe 60-second full-power warm cycle.

new_nodes.label: One-press warm operation
new_nodes.detail: Provides a zero-setting cooking action for common reheating.

ideas.rationale: It removes the mechanical timer knob and replaces it with one universally understood press action.

ideas.title: 02 Color-coded power slots

new_nodes.label: Color-slot power tray
new_nodes.detail: The user slides the tray into a red, yellow, or blue power-color slot.

new_nodes.label: Slot-based power setting
new_nodes.detail: Sets microwave duty cycle through a physical slot rather than a dial.

ideas.rationale: It turns an abstract 5-step power knob into a simple visual matching task.

ideas.title: 03 Transparent Faraday door

new_nodes.label: Transparent-mesh door
new_nodes.detail: A conductive transparent window replaces the dark perforated door.

new_nodes.label: Passive visual monitoring
new_nodes.detail: Lets the user see cooking without needing the interior light.

ideas.rationale: It gives obvious visual feedback without teaching the user to look through a mesh window and rely on a bulb.

ideas.title: 04 Auto-start on door close

new_nodes.label: Door-close start switch
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts the last or default safe cook cycle.

new_nodes.label: Close-to-cook start
new_nodes.detail: Uses door closure as the only required activation step.

ideas.rationale: It converts a familiar physical action, closing the door, into the start command.

ideas.title: 05 Foot-pedal door opener

new_nodes.label: Foot pedal latch
new_nodes.detail: A base pedal releases the door without hand buttons.

new_nodes.label: Hands-free door opening
new_nodes.detail: Provides intuitive access while hands are busy.

ideas.rationale: It removes small-button operation and makes opening the microwave an obvious foot action.

ideas.title: 06 Haptic tray alert

new_nodes.label: Vibrating tray coupler
new_nodes.detail: The tray coupler pulses once when the cycle ends.

new_nodes.label: Haptic ready signal
new_nodes.detail: Signals completion through touch instead of sound or lights.

ideas.rationale: It gives a simple ready cue without requiring the user to interpret bells, beeps, or indicators.

ideas.title: 07 Weight-sensing tray

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable
new_nodes.detail: The turntable measures plate weight to estimate a safe warm time.

new_nodes.label: Weight-based timing
new_nodes.detail: Replaces manual time setting with weight-derived duration.

ideas.rationale: It lets users just place food and start, removing the need to calculate minutes.

ideas.title: 08 Squeeze handle power

new_nodes.label: Pressure-sensing handle
new_nodes.detail: Squeezing the handle lightly or firmly selects soft, medium, or high heating.

new_nodes.label: Squeeze-to-power setting
new_nodes.detail: Uses grip pressure as an intuitive energy-level proxy.

ideas.rationale: It replaces a numbered power dial with a natural squeeze action.

ideas.title: 09 Twist-and-drop puck timer

new_nodes.label: Spring-wound puck timer
new_nodes.detail: A detachable puck is twisted and placed in a slot to start timing.

new_nodes.label: Puck-drop timing
new_nodes.detail: Provides a toy-like, visible countdown without a traditional knob.

ideas.rationale: It makes setting time a single playful action that can be learned by watching once.

ideas.title: 10 LED ring ready

new_nodes.label: Door-ring LED
new_nodes.detail: A glowing ring around the door changes from red to green.

new_nodes.label: Color-ready indication
new_nodes.detail: Signals cooking status through a single color cue.

ideas.rationale: It replaces a mechanical ding and lamp with an instantly understandable traffic-light cue.

ideas.title: 11 Pull-to-open magnetic door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic pull handle
new_nodes.detail: The door holds with a magnet and opens by pulling outward.

new_nodes.label: Pull-to-open door
new_nodes.detail: Uses the most obvious door-opening gesture.

ideas.rationale: It eliminates the push-release latch and lets users operate the door like a fridge.

ideas.title: 12 Static mode-stirrer cavity

new_nodes.label: Fixed RF mode stirrer
new_nodes.detail: A rotating RF reflector distributes energy instead of a glass tray motor.

new_nodes.label: Motor-free even heating
new_nodes.detail: Maintains field distribution without rotating parts.

ideas.rationale: It removes turntable alignment, roller rings, and motor failure from the user's mental model.

ideas.title: 13 Molded self-clean baffle

new_nodes.label: Integrated baffle cover
new_nodes.detail: A smooth molded cavity cover replaces the fragile mica sheet.

new_nodes.label: Splatter-contour cleaning
new_nodes.detail: Keeps waveguide contamination away through shape and surface instead of a separate cover.

ideas.rationale: It removes a confusing part that users might try to clean, remove, or replace.

ideas.title: 14 Thermosiphon cooling fins

new_nodes.label: Passive fin chimney
new_nodes.detail: A vertical fin stack moves cooling air without a fan motor.

new_nodes.label: Fan-free magnetron cooling
new_nodes.detail: Provides thermal cooling through convection and vent geometry.

ideas.rationale: It removes fan noise and maintenance clues that can make users think the appliance is broken or complicated.

ideas.title: 15 Sealed RF power core

new_nodes.label: One-block RF generator
new_nodes.detail: The magnetron, HV transformer, diode, capacitor, and waveguide are sealed as one cartridge.

new_nodes.label: Plug-and-run microwave source
new_nodes.detail: Delivers microwave energy as a black-box module.

ideas.rationale: It hides dangerous and confusing internals behind one simple operational interface.

ideas.title: 16 Composite safety cutoff

new_nodes.label: Composite trip block
new_nodes.detail: Thermal and electrical protection are combined into one sealed trip unit.

new_nodes.label: Combined fault cutoff
new_nodes.detail: Stops power when overheating or overcurrent occurs.

ideas.rationale: It reduces visible safety complexity and prevents users from interpreting trips as setup errors.

ideas.title: 17 Recipe card slot

new_nodes.label: Recipe card slot
new_nodes.detail: A plastic recipe card sets time and power mechanically through cutouts.

new_nodes.label: Card-selected cook cycle
new_nodes.detail: Uses a physical card as the instruction interface.

ideas.rationale: It turns setup into a familiar insert-a-card action instead of manipulating dials.

ideas.title: 18 Ready-glow door panel

new_nodes.label: Glowing door panel
new_nodes.detail: The door panel glows softly during cooking and brightens when ready.

new_nodes.label: Glow-as-ready feedback
new_nodes.detail: Combines cavity illumination and completion signaling into one visual cue.

ideas.rationale: It gives users an obvious state signal without separate lights, timers, or sounds.

ideas.title: 19 Handle-timer lever

new_nodes.label: Timer lever handle
new_nodes.detail: The same door handle is pushed down to set time and pulled to open.

new_nodes.label: One-handle set-and-open
new_nodes.detail: Uses one familiar handle for both timing and access.

ideas.rationale: It reduces two controls to one object and leverages an intuitive handle gesture.

ideas.title: 20 Weight increment button

new_nodes.label: Tap-by-weight button
new_nodes.detail: Each tap adds time proportional to the plate weight measured by the tray.

new_nodes.label: Weight-step timing
new_nodes.detail: Simplifies duration setting to repeated taps.

ideas.rationale: It replaces precise minutes with an easy add-taps-until-done behavior.

ideas.title: 21 Embossed tactile fascia

new_nodes.label: Raised-icon fascia
new_nodes.detail: Large embossed symbols show time and power without words or numbers.

new_nodes.label: Touch-read controls
new_nodes.detail: Lets users identify functions by texture and shape.

ideas.rationale: It makes the control layout self-explanatory without needing to read labels or learn codes.

ideas.title: 22 Full power only defrost by time

new_nodes.label: Single-power switch
new_nodes.detail: The microwave always runs at full power; defrost is done by short taps.

new_nodes.label: Time-only defrost
new_nodes.detail: Uses short duration instead of selecting a low power level.

ideas.rationale: It removes the confusing power-level knob by making time the only user decision.

ideas.title: 23 Drawer microwave

new_nodes.label: Slide drawer cavity
new_nodes.detail: Food is loaded into a front drawer instead of a hinged door.

new_nodes.label: Drawer access operation
new_nodes.detail: Uses a single slide motion to load, close, and seal the cavity.

ideas.rationale: It replaces latch alignment and door swinging with the obvious action of pulling out and pushing in.

ideas.title: 24 Single time-power knob

new_nodes.label: One-knob multifunction
new_nodes.detail: One knob turns to set time and tilts to select power bands.

new_nodes.label: Unified time-power setting
new_nodes.detail: Combines two settings into a single continuous control.

ideas.rationale: It cuts the control surface in half and removes the question of which knob to use.

ideas.title: 25 Tap-anywhere fascia open

new_nodes.label: Piezo fascia tap
new_nodes.detail: Any tap on the front fascia unlatches the door.

new_nodes.label: Tap-to-open door
new_nodes.detail: Makes the whole visible surface the door-open affordance.

ideas.rationale: It eliminates hunting for a specific button and makes tapping the obvious interface.

ideas.title: 26 Optical door interlock

new_nodes.label: Light-slit door sensor
new_nodes.detail: A door-edge light slit detects closure instead of stacked microswitches.

new_nodes.label: Optical door lock
new_nodes.detail: Cuts RF when door closure breaks the optical path.

ideas.rationale: It reduces invisible switch complexity and supports a simpler close-to-safely-run behavior.

ideas.title: 27 Steam whistle end signal

new_nodes.label: Steam whistle louvre
new_nodes.detail: A vent whistle sounds when hot steam reaches a threshold near end of cycle.

new_nodes.label: Steam-driven ready sound
new_nodes.detail: Signals readiness using escaping steam rather than a separate mechanical bell.

ideas.rationale: It turns a familiar kettle cue into a built-in ready signal that needs no learning.

ideas.title: 28 Moisture-stopping tray

new_nodes.label: Humidity-sensing tray
new_nodes.detail: The tray stops heating when steam indicates food is hot enough.

new_nodes.label: Done-by-moisture timing
new_nodes.detail: Replaces clock setting with automatic doneness detection.

ideas.rationale: It lets users put food in and press start without choosing time or power.

ideas.title: 29 Ball-bearing tray

new_nodes.label: Three-ball bearing tray
new_nodes.detail: Three ceramic balls rotate the tray without a roller ring and coupler.

new_nodes.label: Ball-bearing turntable motion
new_nodes.detail: Provides low-friction rotation with fewer parts.

ideas.rationale: It removes confusing multi-part turntable assembly and makes loading easier.

ideas.title: 30 Pull-cord timer

new_nodes.label: Pull-cord timer spool
new_nodes.detail: Pulling a cord winds and releases a spring timer.

new_nodes.label: Pull-to-start timing
new_nodes.detail: Uses cord length as the physical amount of time.

ideas.rationale: It replaces numerical dial reading with a direct pull gesture that can be imitated instantly.

ideas.title: 31 Gravity door start

new_nodes.label: Gravity door stop
new_nodes.detail: Door weight at full close engages a default warm cycle.

new_nodes.label: Door-weight auto start
new_nodes.detail: Uses the physical click of a shut door as the start event.

ideas.rationale: It makes the common closing motion do the work instead of requiring a knob or button.

ideas.title: 32 Lamp-bell combo beacon

new_nodes.label: One-light beacon
new_nodes.detail: A cavity LED blinks during cooking and stays solid when done.

new_nodes.label: Beacon visual alert
new_nodes.detail: Combines illumination and completion signal into one simple light state.

ideas.rationale: It gives a single visible state to monitor instead of separate bell, lamp, and timer behaviors.

ideas.title: 33 Sand-glass cavity timer

new_nodes.label: Sand hourglass insert
new_nodes.detail: A small hourglass shows how much cooking time remains.

new_nodes.label: Sand-countdown timing
new_nodes.detail: Provides an analog visible countdown without numbers.

ideas.rationale: It makes time passing obvious to anyone, including users who dislike clocks and beeps.

ideas.title: 34 Heat-colored indicator tray

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic tray
new_nodes.detail: A thin plate under the tray changes color when the surface becomes hot.

new_nodes.label: Color-ready tray
new_nodes.detail: Signals completion through temperature color change rather than a bell.

ideas.rationale: It uses a familiar color change as a ready signal, reducing the need to monitor sound or controls.

ideas.title: 35 Capacitive top slider

new_nodes.label: Top capacitive slider
new_nodes.detail: One horizontal swipe sets both time and power with a single gesture.

new_nodes.label: Swipe time-power slider
new_nodes.detail: Maps length of swipe to duration and pressure to power.

ideas.rationale: It collapses all setup into one familiar swipe instead of multiple knobs and buttons.

ideas.title: 36 Door-window e-ink status

new_nodes.label: E-ink door film
new_nodes.detail: The door window displays only words like warming and ready.

new_nodes.label: Printed status window
new_nodes.detail: Provides legible status without menus or complex displays.

ideas.rationale: It replaces tiny indicators and sounds with plain readable status that anyone can understand.

ideas.title: 37 Auto-close vent shutter

new_nodes.label: Bimetal vent shutter
new_nodes.detail: Cooling vents open by heat and close automatically after use.

new_nodes.label: Self-closing cooling path
new_nodes.detail: Maintains safe cooling without fan noise or user checks.

ideas.rationale: It removes fan cues and vent-related confusion so users do not suspect faults or need to learn airflow checks.

ideas.title: 38 Magnetic latch start switch

new_nodes.label: Magnetic latch switch
new_nodes.detail: The magnetic latch position itself starts the default cycle.

new_nodes.label: Latch-contact start
new_nodes.detail: Uses door latching as the activation signal.

ideas.rationale: It makes the click of a closed latch the natural start event.

ideas.title: 39 Thermal RF valve stop

new_nodes.label: Bimetal RF valve
new_nodes.detail: A heat-triggered valve reduces power as cavity temperature rises.

new_nodes.label: Heat-actuated cutoff
new_nodes.detail: Ends or softens heating without the user setting exact time.

ideas.rationale: It lets the appliance respond to heat instead of forcing users to choose precise timing.

ideas.title: 40 Color-changing door power tint

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic door tint
new_nodes.detail: The door window darkens or warms with the selected power band.

new_nodes.label: Tint-as-power indicator
new_nodes.detail: Shows heating level through the visible door color.

ideas.rationale: It turns power-level selection into a visible color cue instead of a numbered dial.

ideas.title: 41 Tray-weight lever timer

new_nodes.label: Tray-weight lever
new_nodes.detail: A small lever moves when the loaded tray presses down, setting a rough time.

new_nodes.label: Weight-lever time setting
new_nodes.detail: Uses plate weight as a mechanical proxy for cooking duration.

ideas.rationale: It lets users set time by the same action used to load food.

ideas.title: 42 Hand-cranked turntable

new_nodes.label: Crank turntable
new_nodes.detail: A tiny external crank rotates the tray while cooking.

new_nodes.label: Manual rotation motion
new_nodes.detail: Provides heating uniformity through visible hand motion instead of a motor.

ideas.rationale: It replaces hidden motor behavior with a simple action anyone can copy from a crank radio or food mill.

ideas.title: 43 Spring-loaded start plunger

new_nodes.label: Push-start plunger
new_nodes.detail: A big front plunger is pressed in proportion to how long the user wants to cook.

new_nodes.label: Plunger duration timing
new_nodes.detail: Converts push depth into a mechanical timer setting.

ideas.rationale: It replaces time dialing with the intuitive action of pushing a button in or out.

ideas.title: 44 Automatic steam-clean valve

new_nodes.label: Steam-clean valve
new_nodes.detail: A small valve releases stored steam into the cavity to loosen spills after cooking.

new_nodes.label: Automatic steam wipe
new_nodes.detail: Improves cleanability without user-added water or cleaning steps.

ideas.rationale: It removes a common post-cooking confusion about cleaning and covers while the basic operation stays unchanged.

ideas.title: 45 Door-hung loading tray

new_nodes.label: Door-hung tray
new_nodes.detail: A fold-out tray is attached to the door so food rolls in and out.

new_nodes.label: Door-tray loading
new_nodes.detail: Uses the door itself as a ramp for simple placement.

ideas.rationale: It turns loading into a single roll-in motion instead of balancing plates inside a cavity.

ideas.title: 46 Door-only cooking unit

new_nodes.label: Door-only microwave
new_nodes.detail: The entire appliance runs when the door is shut and food is present.

new_nodes.label: Door-closed cooking
new_nodes.detail: Uses only open and close as the operational interface.

ideas.rationale: It removes all controls and reduces operation to the same action as closing any appliance door.

ideas.title: 47 Pull-to-stop cord

new_nodes.label: Pull stop cord
new_nodes.detail: A visible cord stops the cycle and gives a simple mechanical feedback signal.

new_nodes.label: Pull-to-stop alert
new_nodes.detail: Uses pulling to end cooking and confirm the state change.

ideas.rationale: It gives a tactile, visible stop action instead of asking users to learn timing or cancellation cues.

ideas.title: 48 Color-band knobless fascia

new_nodes.label: Color-band fascia
new_nodes.detail: Fixed colored bands indicate simple low, medium, and high choices with no knob.

new_nodes.label: Color-band power reading
new_nodes.detail: Uses color zones as the only power-level interface.

ideas.rationale: It removes the numbered power knob and gives users a simple color legend to follow.

ideas.title: 49 Lift-out turntable base

new_nodes.label: Lift-out tray base
new_nodes.detail: The whole turntable base lifts out with one tab instead of separate roller parts.

new_nodes.label: Tool-free tray cleaning
new_nodes.detail: Provides rotation support and cleaning as one removable unit.

ideas.rationale: It removes the need to understand and reassemble roller-ring components during everyday use.

ideas.title: 50 Window-only monitoring door

new_nodes.label: Clear window door
new_nodes.detail: The door window acts as the primary feedback channel instead of lamps or sounds.

new_nodes.label: Window-only monitoring
new_nodes.detail: Provides a simple visible view of food state without controls.

ideas.rationale: It gives the clearest possible feedback, so users can judge the appliance by simply looking at the food.
